title: TipsInteractionReadyPayload
description: tips.interaction.ready v1 (OpenVibe.Tips server/domain/interactions.js settle, summary()). The interaction settled: it is active and its effects (overlay alert, chat line, paid message, TTS, media request) are queued. Envelope: subject { type: interaction, id: tint_… }, visibility internal, priority important, actor service:tips. Never emitted for tests or imports.

supporter.description: The supporter, null when external, anonymous or unmapped.

amount.description: Integer amount in currency minor units (Vibes bits).

billing_txn_id.description: The Billing transaction (txn_…) that settled it.

test.description: Simulations never emit events, so false in practice.
